system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Perform these two different actions simultaneously: livestock_generate_otp and livestock_cancel_service. For your information, my booking_id is None, my mobile_number is 9876584836, my aadhaar_number is 100020009182.

function.name: livestock_cancel_service
function.description: Cancels a booked vaccination service. Only possible when service_status is 'requested' or 'assigned' (before administration). Requires session_token. Does NOT refund or modify records. Fails if service is already completed or vaccination administered.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

function.name: livestock_generate_otp
function.description: Sends OTP to the Aadhaar-linked mobile number for livestock vaccination service authentication. Does NOT verify the OTP or create a session. Fails if Aadhaar is invalid or mobile number is not registered.
